fukuoka-to-kumamoto.name: Fukuoka ↔ Kumamoto
fukuoka-to-kumamoto.approx_cost: Kyushu Shinkansen Hakata–Kumamoto (Mizuho/Sakura/Tsubame), about 32–38 min (up to about 8 min longer on some trains since the 18 Sep 2026 post-quake reopening): unreserved ¥5,310, reserved ¥5,840 (normal season; ±¥200 off-peak/peak; one travel site shows ¥6,040). Kyushu Net Hayatoku 7 online discount ¥3,800–4,800.

kumamoto-castle.name: Kumamoto Castle
kumamoto-castle.approx_cost: ¥800 (high school and older), ¥300 (children); with Wakuwakuza ¥850; with Wakuwakuza + Kumamoto Museum ¥1,100
kumamoto-castle.hours: 9:00-17:00 (last entry 16:00 per ticket reseller, other sources say 16:30; keep climb until 16:30); at the 13 Aug 2026 reopening the city announced 9:00-19:00 (last entry 18:00); hours can be extended for events

closed.irregular: Year-end/New Year closure not confirmed. A ticket reseller lists 2026-12-29 and 2027-01-01 as unavailable dates; on 1 Jan 2026 there was a free special opening.

kumamoto-hosokawa-gyobutei.name: Former Hosokawa Gyobu Residence
kumamoto-hosokawa-gyobutei.approx_cost: Building closed; garden free during seasonal openings (per rurubu)
kumamoto-hosokawa-gyobutei.hours: Building closed. Garden opened for a limited time in autumn-leaf and plum seasons (8:30-20:00 per rurubu; ask for late Nov–early Dec)

closed.irregular: Building closed after earthquake damage; garden only during seasonal openings

kumamoto-hosokawa-gyobutei.address_local: 〒860-8601 熊本県熊本市中央区古京町熊本玉名線
